issue.title: RSVP controls are too small to hit
body: I use a head pointer. The + and − buttons for guests are tiny and right next to each other, so I keep pressing the wrong one.
Arrival time only changes if you drag a small handle along the line. Holding a press while moving isn't something I can do reliably, so I'm stuck at 6:00.

task.instruction: With your mouse, trackpad or touch screen, set 3 guests and an arrival time of 7:00 PM, then select Save RSVP.
task.afterReproduce: The + and − buttons are 18 pixels and touching, and arrival time only changes by dragging. Both shut out anyone whose pointer is less precise.

fixes.title: Stylesheet: the guest stepper buttons
fixes.find: .stepper button { width: 18px; height: 18px; padding: 0; font-size: 0.75rem; line-height: 1; }

options.label: Make the + and − symbols bigger
options.replace: .stepper button { width: 18px; height: 18px; padding: 0; font-size: 1.5rem; line-height: 1; }
options.feedback: The symbols got bigger, but the area you have to hit is exactly the same size.

options.label: Make the buttons 20 by 20 pixels
options.replace: .stepper button { width: 20px; height: 20px; padding: 0; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1; }
options.feedback: Closer, but still under the 24 by 24 pixel minimum, and the two buttons still touch.

options.label: Make the buttons 44 by 44 pixels
options.replace: .stepper button { width: 44px; height: 44px; padding: 0; font-size: 1.25rem; line-height: 1; }
options.feedback: Comfortably above the 24 by 24 minimum. 44 pixels is a common recommendation for touch.

options.label: Add an instruction: "Drag the handle to set your time"
options.replace: Drag the handle to set your time.
options.feedback: Instructions don't help someone who can't drag. There needs to be another way to set the time.

options.label: Add role="slider" and tabindex="0" to the track
options.feedback: It's announced as a slider now, but arrow keys, clicks and taps still do nothing. It still only works by dragging.

options.label: Use a native <input type="range">
options.replace: <input type="range" id="arrival" min="17" max="21" step="0.5" value="18" aria-labelledby="arrival-label" aria-valuetext="6:00 PM">
options.feedback: A native range input works with a single click or tap on the track, with arrow keys, and with screen readers. Dragging becomes optional.

merged.headline: Every target is easy to hit.
merged.reply: Three guests, 7:00 PM, first try. I didn't have to fight the page once.
learn: Targets need to be at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels, or have enough space around them.
Bigger symbols don't help if the clickable area stays small.
Anything you can drag must also work with a single click or tap.
